what: The JSON CSV YAML Converter changes data between the three most common text formats: JSON for apps and APIs, CSV for spreadsheets, and YAML for configuration files. Paste your data and pick the target format; the result appears instantly.

It is for developers, data analysts, testers and anyone moving data between a spreadsheet and a program. Nested objects are flattened into dotted columns for spreadsheets and rebuilt when converting back, so you can edit API data in Excel or Google Sheets and turn it into JSON again.
The conversion runs in your browser with the open-source js-yaml library, so your data never leaves your device.
uses: Open API data in a spreadsheet
Turn a JSON response into CSV and open it in Excel, LibreOffice or Google Sheets.
Export a sheet as CSV and convert it to JSON for an app, test or import.
Convert YAML config files to JSON and back, or check that YAML is valid.
Write fixtures in whichever format is easiest and convert them for your code.
Switch separators, for example from semicolon CSV to comma CSV.
tutorial: Paste it into Input, press Open file to load a .json, .csv, .tsv or .yaml file, or press Load sample.
From is set to Detect automatically. JSON starts with { or [, YAML has key: value lines, and anything else is read as CSV. Choose the format yourself if detection is wrong.
Click JSON, CSV or YAML under To. The result updates immediately for inputs up to about 1 MB; for bigger data press Convert.
CSV separator picks comma, semicolon, tab or pipe. First row is column names, Read numbers and true/false, and Rebuild nested data control how CSV is read.
JSON indent sets 2 spaces, 4 spaces, tab or minified. Flatten nested data turns nested objects into dotted columns when writing CSV.
Press Copy result or Download. Use result as input lets you convert the result again, for example to check a round trip.
features: JSON to CSV, CSV to JSON, JSON to YAML, YAML to JSON, CSV to YAML and YAML to CSV.
Flattens objects and lists into dotted columns and rebuilds them.
Quoted values, doubled quotes, line breaks inside cells and Excel byte-order marks are handled.
Comma, semicolon, tab and pipe are detected automatically.
Invalid JSON shows the line and column; invalid YAML shows what went wrong.
CSV files are saved in UTF-8 with Windows line endings so Excel shows every alphabet correctly.
Handles tens of thousands of rows without uploading anything.

example.title: Worked example: JSON to CSV and back
example.text: Press Load sample: three people with id, name, email, active, an address object and a tags list. With To set to CSV, the first line reads id,name,email,active,address.city,address.country,tags.0,tags.1 and Ana's row ends with Lisbon,Portugal,admin,sales. Press Use result as input: the CSV is read back and converted to JSON, and address and tags are nested again exactly as before.

tips: If your spreadsheet uses semicolons (common in many European countries), choose Semicolon as the separator so Excel opens the file in columns.
Keep IDs, phone numbers and postcodes as text by quoting them in JSON or by unticking Read numbers and true/false.
A JSON object with one list inside, like {"users": [...]}, is converted using the list as rows.
Choose Minified JSON to make the result as small as possible for APIs.
Multiple YAML documents separated by --- become a list in JSON.
problems: It says the JSON is not valid
Look at the line and column in the message. Common causes are a trailing comma, single quotes instead of double quotes, or a missing bracket.
Everything ended up in one column
The separator was not detected. Choose the right one under CSV separator.
My CSV was read as YAML
If the first line looks like name: value, set From to CSV / TSV.
Columns like address.city were not nested
Tick Rebuild nested data from column names with dots.
A quoted value is not closed
A cell starts with " but never ends with one. Fix the quote or remove it.
